canonical_title: Anthropic IPO valuation leans on $190-200 billion 2028 revenue forecast
aliases: Anthropic total addressable market over $30 trillion
treatment: Treat the reported $190-200B 2028 revenue forecast, July-end annual revenue run rate above $65B, and reported TAM above $30T as covered. Reinclude only for official filing, revised forecast or TAM, material revenue/run-rate update, pricing range, analyst-day disclosures, IPO timing, margin/profitability disclosures, or other material valuation terms.
known_facts: Reuters reported that Anthropic is projecting roughly $190 billion to $200 billion of 2028 revenue, a figure not previously reported.
Bankers and investors are using forward enterprise-value-to-revenue multiples and are considering Cloudflare, Palantir and SpaceX as reference points ahead of Anthropic's analyst day.
Anthropic's reported revenue run rate exceeded $47 billion by May 2026, up from about $9 billion at the end of 2025.
Reuters reported Anthropic had projected at least $10.9 billion of Q2 2026 revenue and was on track for its first quarterly operating profit of $559 million.

Reuters reported on August 17 that Anthropic's annual revenue run rate topped $65 billion by the end of July 2026, up from more than $47 billion in May; the figure had been shared with investors as part of ongoing financial updates.
Reuters attributed the growth in part to Claude coding-agent traction among developers and enterprise customers.
On August 25, Reuters relayed a Wall Street Journal report that Anthropic is expected to tell investors it sees a total addressable market exceeding $30 trillion.
The reported TAM methodology looks at the full scope of work that could be completed with AI models; Anthropic had not confirmed the figure to Reuters at publication time.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic files for an IPO or discloses an official valuation or price range.
The 2028 revenue forecast or reported TAM materially changes or is officially confirmed.
Anthropic reports another material revenue or revenue-run-rate change.
Analyst-day materials disclose material margin, compute-cost, profitability, TAM methodology or growth assumptions.
IPO timing or structure materially changes.
notes: NEW in 2026-08-15 Midday. FOLLOW_UP in 2026-08-18 Midday: reported annual revenue run rate rose above $65B by end-July from above $47B in May. FOLLOW_UP in 2026-08-26 Midday: WSJ/Reuters reported Anthropic plans to present a TAM above $30T, adding a material valuation narrative but not an official company filing.
